sources.snippet: Awesome Edge AI for Multimodal Agents A curated list of papers, frameworks, benchmarks, and applications for efficient multimodal agents (LLMs, text-to-image, speech, world models, etc.) on mobile and edge devices. Focused on inference engines, optimization, and deployment for real-world use.

sources.title: Ivy-VL: A Lightweight Multimodal Model for Edge Devices
sources.snippet: Ivy-VL is a lightweight multimodal model jointly developed by AI Safeguard, Carnegie Mellon University, and Stanford University. Designed with efficiency, compactness, and high performance in mind, Ivy-VL addresses various challenges related to deploying large multimodal models on edge devices.
